findings: Example notebook assigns uniform radius parameters 0.5 with metric scene scale 0.001, rather than reading subject-specific nerve cross-sections.
Root points are sorted by z and supplemented by ganglion points; entry points are extended into the cord model.
Example applies 100-point spline fitting with smoothing parameter 10.
Cord and dura contours are bridged into surfaces.
The publication describes later manual intersection corrections.
Native Figshare model archive was not acquired; correspondence between every published model and this example script has not been established.
decision: MRI and original annotations are candidates for anatomical source review; generated nerve tubes are not accepted as measured full-fidelity nerve surfaces.
